title: scenarios grader: the asked-back "no figure" check counts list ordinals (1. 2. 3.) and ISO dates in a clarifying reply as figures
body:
triage#1 · hotlong · session_01Q4EjjMnyLqJdzuktEmRPXH

Filed by triage at the request of repo:objectstack#3 (mailbox #32588, comment 6962937578), from area o3-F's iteration-1 diagnosis of the #34958 / #34951 recordings (travel_expense, template `b7ab31a7`). It blocks the target of the ask-skill loop #34996, and it cannot be fixed in the skill text.

## What happens
In `packages/qa/scenarios`, the asked-back "no figure" check treats option ordinals ("1. 2. 3.") and ISO dates ("2026-11-17") in a clarifying reply as figures. In reps 2 and 3 of `dq_travel_spend`, the agent asked back correctly and was still graded as failing.

## Done when
- The check ignores list ordinals and ISO dates in an asked-back reply.
- It is pinned by a test using those two shapes.
- The scorecard notes the grader change, so a round before and a round after are not compared as like for like.

Parent: #34659. Blocks: #34996.
Grade: **p1 · domain:devx · area:ai**. A false fail in the grader caps the maintainer-requested loop's asked-back target.
